other_conditions: New Micro or Small units engaged in manufacturing/servicing except activities listed in the Negative List are eligible.
Investment in Plant & Machinery and Building must be below ₹25 lakhs.
Entrepreneur must have Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part‑II (Permanent Registration) under the MSME Act 2006 filed with the Director of Industries, Lakshadweep or hold Udyog Aadhar registration.
Institutions registered under the Societies Registration Act 1960 and Self‑Help Groups that have not received benefits under any other scheme are eligible.
Applicants must be residents of any inhabited island of Lakshadweep.
benefits_summary: Provides a 25% capital investment subsidy up to ₹6.25 lakhs per enterprise.
documents_required: Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part‑II (Permanent Registration) under MSME Act 2006
Application form as per Department of Industries guidelines
